text:
Good idea execution but with lot of negative loopholes. Food delivery execution is built in this app is very good and amount of options provided for food is very high. In happy path scenario everything works fine. 

But application has lot of problems when it comes to real time scenarios which involves customer order issues. 
1. Worst chat bot for such a good application. AI chat person keeps asking you same questions on repeat if something goes wrong with your order. 
2. Chat bot provides only limited options regarding issues with order in which one can select and gets redirected to another limited number of options such as spill issue or quality issue. Where as I have faced many other issues with my orders which are not listed. 
3. Personal interaction with human being is not possible at all. Hence it becomes tediously exhausting to explain your problem to AI. 
4. Refunds are only provided if you mention something damming serious in the chat bot otherwise just an apology is offered. 
5. Refund is never equivalent to actual amount of the food item. It’s always less. 
6. Price is already hiked per food item by 20-50 Rs. and additional tax is also charged depending on restaurant. And yet customer is not given any sort of explanation or valid refund from Zomato in case there is an issue with an order. 
7. Now a days single delivery person is allocated to multiple order deliveries at the same time. So food gets very cold and dry by the time it reaches your place as delivery persons first delivers another delivery to a location which is not even on the same route. 

I would rather go to a restaurant and pay less and get quality food instead of zomato orders as order issues have significantly increased in last few years.
title: Good idea execution but with lot of negative loopholes

Delivery scam. One of the worst experiences I have ever had with a food delivery platform. I placed an order with a promised delivery time of around 35 minutes, but ended up waiting almost an hour. When the food finally arrived, it was completely cold and extremely disappointing.

What made the situation even worse was Zomato's customer support. I contacted support expecting a reasonable resolution, but Ujjwal was assigned to my complaint and handled it extremely poorly. Instead of addressing the fact that I received cold food after waiting almost an hour, he simply argued that the order was only 2 minutes late.

Then, without my consent or approval, he cancelled the order himself. I have never experienced such poor handling of a customer complaint. To make matters worse, my Cash on Delivery option was also disabled without my permission.

This is absolutely unacceptable. A customer should not have to pay for cold food, wait far beyond the expected delivery time, and then deal with a support representative who refuses to provide a proper resolution and makes decisions on the customer's behalf.

The entire experience was frustrating, disrespectful, and completely unacceptable. Zomato has seriously disappointed me, and after this experience, I have no reason to trust the platform again. I will definitely reconsider using Zomato in the future and would not recommend it to anyone who expects reliable delivery and proper customer support.
title: Delivery scam

Worst app. Honestly, Zomato has become one of the worst food-ordering apps in terms of delivery experience. Orders are constantly getting delayed, and this is not just a one-time issue. Today was literally the 9th time I’ve faced the same problem. At this point, ordering food through Zomato feels more frustrating than convenient.

What made today even worse was the customer service experience. I reached out to customer support hoping they would actually help resolve the issue, but the response was extremely disappointing. Instead of properly understanding the situation or offering a reasonable solution, the issue was handled very poorly.

The worst part was that my order was cancelled without even asking me or getting my confirmation. I was waiting for my food, and suddenly the order was cancelled. Customers should at least be informed and given a choice before something like this is done.

This has happened way too many times now, and the repeated delays combined with such poor customer service are extremely frustrating. Zomato seriously needs to improve its delivery reliability and customer support because experiences like this make customers lose trust in the platform.

text:
Worst Delivery in Solapur. Zomato has grown significantly because of its wide geographic reach and large customer base. However, with this growth, the quality of service and customer support seems to have declined.

Delivery timelines are often not met, and when there is a delay or an issue with an order, getting meaningful support from customer service can be extremely difficult. Even as a Zomato Gold member, I don’t feel that the membership provides any meaningful priority or additional care when problems occur.

If customers are paying extra for a membership, they should receive a corresponding level of service and support. At the very least, there should be a reliable way to reach a customer service executive and get a proper resolution when an order doesn’t arrive within the committed time.

Growth in customer numbers is important, but maintaining service quality and customer trust should be equally important. Currently, the experience makes it feel like membership status doesn’t really matter when you actually need support.
title: Worst Delivery in Solapur
